replace.k: A Brooklyn kid made into the super soldier Captain America
st: Steve takes Erskine's serum, fights HYDRA as Captain America, and crashes in the ice, waking almost seventy years later.
Steve leads the Avengers against Loki and the Chitauri in the Battle of New York.
Steve uncovers HYDRA inside S.H.I.E.L.D., downs its helicarriers, and learns the Winter Soldier is Bucky.
Steve fights Ultron in Sokovia with the Avengers, then starts training a new team at the Avengers Facility.
Steve and Sam hold Bucky, his metal arm pinned in a vise, and Sam says he knows a guy who can help.
Steve rejects the Sokovia Accords to protect Bucky, fights Tony, then breaks his allies out of the Raft.
Steve stars in old fitness and detention videos at Midtown High, though a coach admits he is probably a war criminal now.
Steve's team returns to fight Thanos's army in Wakanda, but Thanos snaps and half of all life turns to dust.
At the Avengers Compound, Steve and the survivors watch Fury's pager when Carol Danvers appears.
Steve leads the Time Heist, lifts Mjolnir against Thanos, then returns the Stones and stays in the past with Peggy.

k: Steve Rogers's best friend, a Howling Commando
The Winter Soldier, a brainwashed HYDRA assassin
A free man trying to make amends
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
A congressman and one of the New Avengers
tm: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
st: Bucky fights beside Steve with the Howling Commandos, then falls from a HYDRA train in the Alps.
Bucky returns as HYDRA's Winter Soldier, but pulls Steve from the river after their battle.
Steve and Sam hold Bucky in a workshop, his metal arm pinned in a vise, while they look for help.
Framed for the Vienna bombing, Bucky fights beside Steve, then chooses to go back into cryo-sleep in Wakanda.
Bucky wakes in Wakanda, where Shuri is helping him recover from his HYDRA conditioning.
Bucky gets a new arm and fights Thanos's army in Wakanda, then turns to dust in the Snap.
Restored, Bucky fights in the final battle and watches Steve hand his shield to Sam.
Pardoned, Bucky joins Sam against the Flag Smashers, breaks Zemo out to help, and makes amends for his past.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now running for Congress, Bucky comforts Sam when he doubts himself as Captain America.
Now a congressman, Bucky helps Yelena's group face the Void and becomes one of the New Avengers.

k: An SSR agent who believes in Steve Rogers
An SSR agent underestimated by her bosses
st: Peggy trains Steve in Project Rebirth, fights HYDRA beside him, and hears his last call before the crash.
In 1945, Peggy and the SSR raid a HYDRA base in Austria and seize its strange artifacts.
Peggy secretly clears Howard Stark's name, faces Leviathan in New York, then Zero Matter in Los Angeles.
Brushed aside at the SSR, Peggy recovers the Zodiac alone, and Howard Stark brings her in to lead S.H.I.E.L.D.
In 1970, Steve glimpses Peggy at Camp Lehigh, and later he returns to the past to share his life with her.
In 1989, Peggy sits with Howard at S.H.I.E.L.D. when Hank Pym quits over his shrinking formula.
Elderly and losing her memory, Peggy welcomes Steve to her bedside in Washington.
In a vision Wanda puts in Steve's mind, Peggy waits for him in a dance hall and tells him the war is over.
Peggy dies in her sleep in London, and her niece Sharon speaks at her funeral.
Captured by the Ten Rings, Tony builds a suit to escape, stops Obadiah Stane, and tells the world he is Iron Man.
Dying from palladium poisoning, Tony creates a new element and beats Vanko's drones at the Stark Expo.
In a bar, Tony tells General Ross that a team is being put together.
Tony joins the Avengers and flies a nuke through the portal to stop the Chitauri.
Tony loses his home to the Mandarin's attack, exposes Aldrich Killian, and has the shrapnel removed from his chest.
Tony builds Ultron to protect the world, then helps the Avengers stop it in Sokovia.
Tony signs the Sokovia Accords and fights Steve, then learns Bucky killed his parents.
Tony keeps watch on Peter, takes back his suit after the ferry disaster, then offers him a place with the Avengers.
Tony fights Thanos on Titan and is stabbed, then watches Peter turn to dust.
Tony solves time travel for the Heist, then snaps Thanos's army away with the Stones and dies.

k: Tony's best friend, an Air Force officer
st: Rhodey finds Tony in the desert and later covers for him with the military and the press.
Rhodey takes one of Tony's suits to the Air Force and fights Vanko's drones as War Machine.
Rebranded as the Iron Patriot, Rhodey is captured by Killian's men and helps Tony save the President.
Rhodey joins the battle in Sokovia, then becomes one of the new Avengers.
Rhodey sides with Tony over the Accords and is badly hurt when Vision's blast hits him by mistake.
Walking with braces, Rhodey fights Thanos's army in Wakanda and survives the Snap.
At the Avengers Compound, Rhodey is with the survivors when Carol Danvers arrives looking for Fury.
Rhodey goes to Morag with Nebula for the Time Heist and fights in the final battle.
Rhodey stands with Sam at the Smithsonian as Sam hands Steve's shield over to the museum.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
A Skrull named Raava has been posing as Rhodey, and the real Rhodes is freed from a Skrull prison when Gravik falls.

k: Head of security at Stark Industries
st: Happy drives Tony Stark around and keeps an eye on him.
Happy boxes with Tony, then drives Natasha into Hammer's facility and takes down a guard.
Now head of security, Happy tails Savin and is badly hurt in the Mandarin's bombing at the Chinese Theatre.
Happy watches over Peter Parker for Tony, misses his warnings, and moves the Avengers' gear out of Stark Tower.
Happy stays close to Pepper and Morgan and attends Tony's funeral.
Happy watches over Peter in Europe, helps him beat Mysterio, and starts dating May.
Happy helps May and Peter after Mysterio's reveal, then forgets Peter after Strange's spell.
Happy turns down Wade Wilson, a visitor from another universe, when he asks to join the Avengers.
In 1995, rookie agent Coulson helps Fury and Carol Danvers slip out of a S.H.I.E.L.D. lockdown.
Coulson approaches Tony and Pepper for S.H.I.E.L.D. and helps Pepper confront Obadiah Stane.
Coulson keeps an eye on Tony for Fury, then is sent to New Mexico, where a strange hammer has been found.
On his way to New Mexico, Coulson calmly stops a robbery at a gas station.
A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
Coulson takes charge of the S.H.I.E.L.D. site around Mjolnir and questions Thor.
Coulson and Sitwell send Tony Stark to spoil the Council's plan to recruit Emil Blonsky.
Coulson gathers the heroes, and Loki stabs him with the scepter, uniting the Avengers.
Brought back to life, Coulson leads a new S.H.I.E.L.D. team and rebuilds the agency as its Director.
No longer Director, Coulson talks with Yo-Yo, then flies off with Mack to track down the rogue Daisy.
Dying after a deal with the Ghost Rider, Coulson retires to Tahiti with May and spends his last days there.

k: A former spy working in space
st: In 1995, agent Fury teams up with Carol Danvers against the Kree, losing an eye to Goose.
Fury visits Tony Stark to talk about the Avengers Initiative.
Fury finds Tony at a donut shop, has Natasha ease his poisoning, and leaves him a box of Howard's old files.
Fury shows Erik Selvig the Tesseract and asks him to study it.
Fury greets Steve in Times Square after he wakes from the ice, almost seventy years later.
Fury assembles the Avengers to stop Loki and defies the Council's order to nuke New York.
Fury survives a Winter Soldier attack, fakes his death, and helps Steve bring down HYDRA within S.H.I.E.L.D.
Fury scolds Coulson over his damaged plane, then helps the team beat John Garrett and makes Coulson Director.
Fury finds the Avengers at Clint's farm, then brings a helicarrier to Sokovia to carry its people to safety.
Fury sends a signal to Carol Danvers on his pager before he turns to dust.
Restored after the Snap, Fury stands among the mourners at Tony's funeral.
Fury is revealed to be in space on a Skrull ship, with Talos posing as him on Earth.
Fury returns to Earth to stop Gravik's Skrull rebels, then leaves with his wife Varra for S.A.B.E.R.
From his S.A.B.E.R. station, Fury helps Carol, Monica and Kamala stop Dar-Benn.

k: A scientist who turns into the Hulk
st: Hunted by General Ross, Bruce seeks a cure, then lets the Hulk out to stop the Abomination.
Bruce joins the Avengers, and the Hulk smashes Loki in the Battle of New York.
Tony tells Bruce the whole story of his fight with the Mandarin, but Bruce falls asleep listening.
Bruce helps create Ultron and Vision, then flies off in a Quinjet as the Hulk.
The Hulk fights Thor as Sakaar's champion, then turns back into Bruce and helps fight Hela.
Thanos beats the Hulk, and Bruce warns Earth, then fights in Wakanda in the Hulkbuster armor.
At the Avengers Compound, Bruce is among the survivors when Carol Danvers arrives looking for Fury.
Now Smart Hulk, Bruce joins the Time Heist and uses the Stones to bring back everyone lost in the Snap.
By hologram, Bruce helps Wong and Carol study the Ten Rings, which are sending out an unknown signal.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Bruce trains his cousin Jen after his blood gives her powers, then returns from Sakaar with his son Skaar.
Bruce helps Peter build an inhibitor, until Jean Grey makes him the Hulk and Spider-Man calms him down.

k: Odin's son, the God of Thunder
st: Banished to Earth without his powers, Thor proves worthy of Mjolnir again and stops Loki.
Thor comes to Earth for Loki, fights with the Avengers against the Chitauri, and takes Loki home.
Thor fights Malekith to save Jane and the Nine Realms, then turns down the throne of Asgard.
Thor fights Ultron, helps bring Vision to life, and leaves to learn about the Infinity Stones.
Missing from the Accords fight, Thor shares a flat in Australia with an office worker named Darryl.
Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl
Thor asks Stephen Strange to help him and Loki find their father, Odin.
Thor loses Mjolnir to Hela, escapes Sakaar, and leads his people away as Asgard falls.
Thor survives Thanos's attack, forges Stormbreaker, and strikes Thanos, but not in the head.
Thor gets the Reality Stone in 2013, fights Thanos, then names Valkyrie king and leaves with the Guardians.
Thor faces Gorr with Jane, Valkyrie and Korg, loses Jane, and adopts Gorr's daughter Love.
Undercover as Natalie Rushman, Natasha watches Tony for S.H.I.E.L.D. and storms Hammer's facility.
Natasha brings Bruce in, frees Clint from Loki's control, and closes the portal with the scepter.
Natasha helps Steve expose HYDRA, dumps S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets online, then faces Congress.
Natasha grows close to Bruce, fights Ultron in Sokovia, then trains new Avengers with Steve.
Natasha signs the Accords, then lets Steve and Bucky escape and becomes a fugitive.
On the run, Natasha reunites with her Red Room family and frees the Widows from Dreykov.
Natasha fights Thanos's army in Wakanda with Steve's team.
At the Avengers Compound, Natasha watches Fury's pager when Carol Danvers arrives looking for him.
Natasha keeps the Avengers going for five years, then gives her life on Vormir for the Soul Stone.

k: A Queens teen with spider powers
st: Tony recruits Queens teen Peter Parker, who fights Steve's team as Spider-Man in Germany.
Peter stops the Vulture without Tony's help and turns down a place in the Avengers.
Peter fights Thanos on Titan and turns to dust in Tony's arms.
Restored, Peter fights in the final battle and mourns Tony.
Before his school trip, Peter rushes around Queens checking off his to-do list.
On a school trip, Peter is tricked by Mysterio and beats him, but Mysterio reveals his identity.
Exposed as Spider-Man, Peter loses May, then has Strange make the world forget him.
Forgotten by all, Peter protects New York alone, stops Jean Grey, and meets Ned again.

replace.k: A hacker called Skye who joins Coulson's team
st: In season 1, the hacker Skye joins Coulson's team and trains to be a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.
In season 2, Terrigen Mist gives her earthquake powers, and she learns her birth name is Daisy Johnson.
In season 3, Daisy leads the Secret Warriors, falls under Hive's control, and loses Lincoln.
Gone rogue as the vigilante Quake, Daisy saves Elena from Victor Ramon's men and later covers for her.
In season 4, Daisy returns to S.H.I.E.L.D. and goes into the Framework to free her friends from Aida.
In season 5, she is sent to 2091 with the team and helps free the Lighthouse from the Kree.
In season 6, Daisy leads a search through space for Fitz.
In season 7, she fights the Chronicoms across time, then explores space with Sousa and her sister Kora.

replace.k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. engineer and weapons expert
st: In season 1, Fitz builds the team's gadgets alongside his best friend, Jemma Simmons.
Trapped underwater with Simmons, Fitz confesses his love and suffers brain damage saving her.
In season 3, Fitz brings Simmons back from an alien planet, and the two finally come together.
Fitz and Simmons examine Yo-Yo at the base, unaware she is hunting the man who killed her cousin.
In season 4's Framework, Fitz becomes the Doctor, a HYDRA leader, and his memories of it haunt him.
In season 5, Fitz freezes himself to follow the team to 2091, then marries Simmons back home.
Fitz dies in the fight with Talbot, but an earlier version of him is still frozen somewhere in space.
In season 6, Fitz wakes in space and is captured with Simmons by the Chronicoms.
In season 7, Fitz helps defeat the Chronicoms, then retires with Simmons to raise their daughter Alya.

k: A long-lived mutant with bone claws
Wolverine, a clawed mutant with an adamantium skeleton
st: In 1962, Logan tells Erik and Charles to get lost when they try to recruit him at a bar.
Logan fights wars beside Victor, quits Team X, then becomes Weapon X and loses his memory to an adamantium bullet.
A cage fighter in Canada, Logan saves Rogue from Sabretooth and joins the X-Men to rescue her from Magneto.
Logan faces Stryker and Lady Deathstrike at Alkali Lake and loses Jean when she stays behind to save the team.
When Jean returns as the Phoenix and tears Alcatraz apart, Logan reaches her and kills her to save everyone.
Haunted by Jean, Logan goes to Japan, loses his healing for a time, and protects Mariko Yashida.
Kitty sends his mind to 1973 to unite young Charles and Erik; he wakes in a new 2023 where the X-Men live.
In 1983, Stryker holds him as Weapon X until Jean frees him and he tears his way out into the snow.
In 2029, an aging Logan protects Laura, kills X-24, and dies in her arms near the border.
Wade digs Logan's adamantium skeleton out of his grave and uses it as a weapon against TVA agents.

replace.k: Scott Summers, the X-Men's field leader
st: Cyclops leads the X-Men in the field against the Sentinels, Magneto, and the Brotherhood.
He marries Jean and learns the space pirate Corsair is his father.
Cyclops is in the Danger Room when Spider-Man comes to Xavier for help with his mutation.
With Jean and Logan, he brings Magneto word that Xavier is dying.
Scott and Jean's son Nathan is born, but Sinister infects him and Bishop takes him to the future.
After Bastion's war, Asteroid M's explosion throws Scott and Jean into 3960 A.D.
In the future, they help Nathan escape Apocalypse's followers, then return to the 1990s.
Back home, Scott fights Danger on Genosha, and Rogue frees him from Apocalypse's control.
Storm defeats Callisto to free Cyclops from the Morlocks and survives her claustrophobia on Genosha.
She resists the Shadow King and refuses to marry the alien tyrant Arkon.
Storm questions Spider-Man when he comes to the X-Mansion seeking a cure.
Spider-Man brings Storm to the Beyonder's planet, where she helps defeat the Red Skull and Doom.
The X-Cutioner's blast strips Storm's powers, and she leaves the team.
With Forge's help, she defeats the Adversary and regains her powers.
Lost in time after Asteroid M explodes, she is found by Forge in 3960 A.D. and returns home.
Xavier names Storm headmistress of his school.

replace.k: Charles Xavier, founder of the X-Men
st: Xavier leads the X-Men and faces Magneto, his old friend.
Powerless in the Savage Land with Magneto, he is captured by Sinister and freed by the X-Men.
Xavier tells Spider-Man, who fears his growing mutation, that he cannot cure him.
Gyrich gravely wounds Xavier, and Lilandra takes him into space to be healed.
Healed and engaged to Lilandra, Xavier returns to Earth after a vision of the Genosha massacre.
He stops Magneto's blackout, then Asteroid M's explosion throws him into ancient Egypt.
He watches Apocalypse kill Magneto and is rescued by Bishop.
Xavier moves the X-Men to Genosha as X-Corp and faces Apocalypse inside Gambit's mind.

k: A shy Queens teen with spider powers
A Columbia student and the Bugle's photographer
st: Bitten on a field trip, Peter lets a thief escape who then kills Uncle Ben, beats the Green Goblin, and stays just friends with MJ.
Peter's powers fade and he quits, then stops Doc Ock's runaway train, and Mary Jane leaves her wedding to be with him.
An alien symbiote darkens Peter until he tears it off, then he forgives Sandman, and Harry dies saving him from Venom.
Pulled into another universe, Peter helps cure the villains, stops Peter from killing Norman, and is sent home by Strange's spell.

k: A Midtown Science High student with spider powers
A new graduate, Spider-Man of New York
st: Left with May and Ben as a boy, Peter is bitten at Oscorp, becomes Spider-Man, stops the Lizard, and tells Gwen his secret.
Peter stops Electro but cannot save Gwen from a fatal fall, then returns as Spider-Man to face the Rhino.
Pulled into another universe, Peter helps cure the villains, catches MJ in a fall, and is sent home by Strange's spell.

k: An ESU student and Bugle photographer
st: Bitten by an irradiated spider, Peter lets a thief go, and the same man kills his Uncle Ben.
As Spider-Man, he battles the Lizard, the Spider-Slayers and the Kingpin's agents.
An alien symbiote bonds to his costume, and he tears it free with a church bell.
His mutation turns him into the Man-Spider, until Kraven and the Punisher help cure him.
Mary Jane vanishes into a portal in his fight with the Green Goblin.
He marries Mary Jane on her return, then learns she is a clone when she dissolves.
On the Beyonder's world, he leads heroes against Doctor Doom, the Red Skull and others.
He leads Spider-Men from other realities against Spider-Carnage, and Madame Web helps him seek Mary Jane.
Spider-Man sees Magneto's pulse wave sweep the world, and Peter later watches Asteroid M fall on a TV with Mary Jane and Flash.

k: A Midtown High junior and Bugle photographer
st: Months after Uncle Ben's death, Spider-Man faces the Vulture and the Big Man's Enforcers.
He finds the Green Goblin is Harry, driven by an Oscorp formula, and keeps the secret.
The alien symbiote gives him a black suit, but with Uncle Ben's memory he casts it off, and it bonds to Eddie.
He saves Gwen from the Master Planner and his new Sinister Six.
After Venom outs his identity, he separates Eddie from the symbiote for good.
He learns Walter Hardy was the burglar who killed Uncle Ben.
He leaves Liz for Gwen and unmasks the true Green Goblin, Norman Osborn, who fakes his death.
He stands among the Spider-Society's many members.

k: A blind lawyer and masked vigilante in Hell's Kitchen
Daredevil, the blind lawyer guarding Hell's Kitchen
A lawyer leading the fight against Mayor Fisk
st: Matt fights Hell's Kitchen's crime lords by night and, in a new armored suit, beats Wilson Fisk and leaves him to the police.
Daredevil clashes with the Punisher, fights the Hand beside Elektra, and reveals his secret to Karen.
Matt joins Jessica, Luke and Danny against the Hand and is buried with Elektra as Midland Circle collapses.
Nursed back to health at the orphanage, Matt foils Fisk's frame-up and sends him back to prison.
In a flashback, Daredevil fights Maya Lopez to a draw during a job she carries out for Fisk.
As Peter Parker's lawyer, Matt gets the charges against him dropped and catches a brick thrown through the window.
In Los Angeles, Matt faces Jennifer Walters in court, then teams up with her as Daredevil against Leap-Frog's thugs.
After Bullseye kills Foggy, Matt hangs up the suit, returns to save Angela from Muse, then rallies cops against Fisk's martial law.
Matt leads the resistance, reveals he is Daredevil at Karen's trial, and is jailed after Fisk leaves New York.

k: A Union Allied secretary framed for murder
Nelson and Murdock's assistant, turning reporter
A reporter for the New York Bulletin
Matt's partner at Nelson, Murdock & Page
st: Framed at Union Allied, Karen joins Nelson and Murdock, digs into Fisk with Ben Urich, and kills James Wesley.
Karen helps defend Frank Castle, starts writing for the Bulletin, and learns that Matt is Daredevil.
Karen waits out the Hand's attack under police protection and mourns Matt after Midland Circle falls.
Still Frank's friend, Karen publishes a bomber's letter and is taken hostage by him until Frank frees her.
Karen confronts Fisk, survives Dex's attack on Clinton Church, and rejoins Matt and Foggy as a partner.
Karen visits a wounded Frank in the hospital and sets off the fire alarms to help him escape.
After Foggy's death Karen moves away, then returns to help Matt and Frank uncover Fisk's plans for Red Hook.
Karen fights Fisk beside Matt, is arrested at a City Hall protest, and goes free when her case is dismissed.
Karen appears only as a vision in Frank Castle's mind, scolding him for his failures but also comforting him.

k: Matt's best friend and law partner
Matt's best friend and law partner
A lawyer at Jeri Hogarth's firm
Matt's partner at Nelson, Murdock & Page
st: In a flashback, Foggy and Matt win an early case for his old neighbor Ray McCoy and give him their savings.
Foggy opens Nelson and Murdock with Matt, learns he is the vigilante, and stands with him to bring down Fisk.
Foggy leads Frank Castle's defense, splits with Matt over his secrets, and takes a job at Jeri Hogarth's firm.
At Hogarth's firm, Foggy gets Luke Cage out of prison and later mourns Matt after Midland Circle.
Foggy offers to help Jeri fight her partners after her diagnosis, but she turns him away.
Foggy represents Luke in Cockroach's assault suit and finds him a paid appearance to cover the settlement.
Foggy runs for district attorney against Fisk and helps bring Agent Nadeem's testimony to light.
Celebrating with his friends at Josie's, Foggy is shot dead by Bullseye.

k: A young Skrull refugee, Talos's daughter
A Skrull rebel secretly spying on Gravik for Talos
st: Talos's young daughter hides with Skrull refugees in Mar-Vell's orbiting lab, then leaves with Carol to find a new home.
Spying on Gravik for Talos, G'iah survives his bullet with Extremis, kills him with the Harvest's powers, and teams up with Sonya.
